prompt: A scaled reptilian beast stands in side profile facing south-west on cracked stone ground. Its hind half is deep emerald green with vivid scales, but its front half has been drained of all color into a flat bone-gray colorless husk, the boundary a sharp washing line where vivid color fades to gray. Its bleached head and shoulders are dissolving into drifting white motes of light, crumbling away as if erased. The only source of light is the cold white glow of the dissolving edge. The background is a dim grey temple hall.

A vivid crimson-and-gold winged serpent recoils, its body caught mid-transformation: the color visibly bleaching out of it from the head down, the front already a flat colorless gray stone-like husk while the tail still glows red. The gray bleached portion is crumbling into a spray of white motes and light, being erased into nothing. Cold white luminescence pours from the dissolving line. The background is a shadowed cathedral interior in muted blue-grey.
